import json,os,signal,subprocess,shutil
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone
signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM,lambda *args:(_ for _ in ()).throw(TimeoutError("read-only status timeout"))); signal.alarm(25)
root=Path("/root/LCRSeg/runs/di_dmpa_gate1c_v22/9593908bd36f7f833e385a70b2b772b7a8c84d22/attempt1")
out=dict(observed_remote_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),output_exists=root.exists(),receipts={},processes=[])
for name in ("GATE1C_V2_RUN_METADATA.json","GATE1C_V2_INPUT_AUDIT.json","CACHE_REUSE_AUDIT.json","PHASE_validation_metrics.json","PHASE_poe_metrics.json","PHASE_draw0.json","PHASE_noise.json","PHASE_posterior.json","PHASE_poe.json","NUMERICAL_COMPARISON_AUDIT.json","EXECUTION_COMPLETION.json","GATE1C_V22_STATUS.json","FAILURE_controller.json","FAILURE_after_error_audit.json"):
    path=root/name
    if not path.exists(): continue
    try:
        r=json.loads(path.read_text())
        out["receipts"][name]={k:r[k] for k in ("status","started_at_utc","controller_pid","cases","pixels","cache_bytes","cache_reuse_approved","new_model_forwards","counts","new_probe_guards","error","elapsed_seconds") if k in r}
    except (ValueError,OSError): out["receipts"][name]={"read":"not complete yet"}
out["failures"]=[p.name for p in root.glob("FAILURE_*.json")]
out["probe_result_files"]=len(list(root.glob("probes/*/*/result.json")))
out["manifest_exists"]=(root/"GATE1C_V2_ARTIFACT_MANIFEST.json").exists()
log=root/"controller.log"
if log.exists():
    with log.open("rb") as h: h.seek(max(0,log.stat().st_size-1800)); out["controller_log_tail"]=h.read().decode(errors="replace")
for proc in Path("/proc").iterdir():
    if not proc.name.isdigit() or int(proc.name)==os.getpid(): continue
    try: argv=[x.decode(errors="replace") for x in (proc/"cmdline").read_bytes().split(b"\0") if x]
    except OSError: continue
    if "di_dmpa_gate1c_v2.runner" in argv: out["processes"].append(dict(pid=int(proc.name),argv=argv))
out["gpus"]=subprocess.check_output(["nvidia-smi","--query-gpu=index,memory.used,utilization.gpu","--format=csv,noheader"],text=True,timeout=10)
out["disk_free_bytes"]=shutil.disk_usage("/root/LCRSeg").free
out["phase_logs"]={p.name:p.stat().st_size for p in root.glob("*.log")}
print(json.dumps(out,indent=2),flush=True)
